findings.text: follow-on: the new comment asserts a direct-VPN browser route (https://nakasvr26.iferc.org/wiki/WebHome.html) on nakasvr26, but the sibling fragment docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/twiki-attachment-probe.html, landed the same morning, concludes "nakasvr26 hosts no web server and no wiki" (no httpd/nginx binary, no /var/www). A worker cannot reach nakasvr26 to test liveness (services are workstation-only) and the plan's node 1 directs this URL, so the node implemented the directive correctly; the two must be reconciled by the coordinator or lead before the URL is treated as live.

item_verdicts.goal: the node-1 goal is to correct browser.services to the live nakasvr26 URLs and record both viewing routes; jt-60sa.yaml:327 lists twiki_code and server_docs only, the comment at jt-60sa.yaml:321-323 carries the direct-VPN URL and the ssh tunnel command, and the retired twiki_main entry and twiki_html/8802 path are removed.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states 59 passed EXIT=0, names baseline_suite and after_suite (both completed, failure_count 0) and a negative_control_log at EXIT=1, so added_failure_count and added_failure_ids are derivable and zero; its orientation_write_paths overstate by naming a fragment and figures dir that were not produced.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares imas_codex/config/facilities/jt-60sa.yaml, tests/config/test_jt60sa_exclusions.py, a wiki-browser-config evidence fragment and a figures dir; git diff --stat fde2c0555..b2cb7c1e5 touches exactly the first two and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the new guard fires: running its body against a base-shaped config (twiki_main restored) raises AssertionError at tests/config/test_jt60sa_exclusions.py:102, and the reviewed negative-browser.log records the same failure at EXIT=1, so the guard is shown to refuse rather than merely pass.
justifications.evidence: the manifest names its arms by baseline_suite (fde2c0555, exit 0, completed true, failure_count 0) and after_suite (b2cb7c1e5, exit 0, completed true, failure_count 0); I re-ran the exact gate at head myself (59 passed, EXIT=0, clean tree) and re-derived the guard's refusal independently; the shortfall is that the declared fragment and figures write paths were never produced, so the node's evidence lives only in the manifest.
justifications.fit: test_browser_services_match_port_forwards is named by the mechanism it checks and extends tests/config/test_jt60sa_exclusions.py, the module that already owns the jt-60sa facility-config assertions; the config comment states the route rather than a plan label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: jt-60sa.yaml:327 browser.services now names only twiki_code (https://localhost:8800/wiki/WebHome.html) and server_docs (https://localhost:8801/), matching the two port_forwards by name and the wiki_sites paths, and jt-60sa.yaml:321-323 records both viewing routes (the direct IFERC VPN URL and the ssh -N -L 8800:nakasvr26.iferc.org:443 jt-60sa tunnel); the retired twiki_main entry and the stale jt-60sa-twiki-forward.service reference are gone, which is exactly the node-1 deliverable.
justifications.reuse: the change reuses get_facility and the existing jt-60sa test module and forks no new accessor; a search over imas_codex for a browser.services reader found only the BrowserConfig model at imas_codex/config/models.py:344, so no second owner was created.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat fde2c0555..b2cb7c1e5 touches only imas_codex/config/facilities/jt-60sa.yaml and tests/config/test_jt60sa_exclusions.py, both inside the declared write paths, with no dependency, schema or unrelated config change.
